title: Verify: AdminApp execution action error display unit tests
summary: Mocked-fetch tests for actionError, 401 and clearing.
acceptance_criteria: Old error cleared on new action
definition_of_done: Tests and npm run typecheck pass

steps.action: Add tests using fixtures from tests/fixtures/api.ts: (1) retry endpoint returns 500 JSON {error:'boom'} and asserts the Execution region shows that message in role alert; (2) approve endpoint returns 401 and asserts the 'Admin token' field is shown again with 'Invalid token'; (3) first action fails then second succeeds and asserts the earlier message is gone; (4) fetch rejecting with a non-Error value asserts 'Request failed'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx && npx tsc --noEmit
steps.expected: All tests pass and typecheck reports no errors.
